ruleDefinitions.name: Microsoft Defender Tamper Protection Trigger
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects blocked attempts to change any of Defender's settings such as "Real Time Monitoring" and "Behavior Monitoring" Note: Unmapped fields: Value

sequences.query: (event_id = 5013 AND (Value = RGX("\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\DisableAntiSpyware$") OR Value = RGX("\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\DisableAntiVirus$") OR Value = RGX("\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\Scan\\\\DisableArchiveScanning$") OR Value = RGX("\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\Scan\\\\DisableScanningNetworkFiles$") OR Value = RGX("\\\\Real\\-Time\\ Protection\\\\DisableRealtimeMonitoring$") OR Value = RGX("\\\\Real\\-Time\\ Protection\\\\DisableBehaviorMonitoring$") OR Value = RGX("\\\\Real\\-Time\\ Protection\\\\DisableIOAVProtection$") OR Value = RGX("\\\\Real\\-Time\\ Protection\\\\DisableScriptScanning$")))
